death.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγιος Γενεσιος Επισκοπος Κλερμοντ (; - 662)» and the entry says he fell asleep in peace in 662. The page gives no year of birth and dates his life to the seventh century.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Γενέσιος Επίσκοπος Κλερμόντ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. saint.gr's head line dates him «(; - 662)» and the entry is two sentences. Clermont is his see and `locations` is left out. The corpus keeps nobody of this name. No hymn is printed. The entry calls him Άγιος in its first sentence and Όσιος in its second, which is the page's own inconsistency and is left as read: `types` follow the see the page gives him.
